note: Canonical instructional intent identifiers. Projected from the Print intent catalogue by scripts/export-contracts.ts — edit the source catalogue, never this file. Native inventory (valid_objects, generation guidance) is deliberately dropped.

orient.label: Orient
orient.pedagogical_role: Open attention and establish a reason to learn

compare.label: Compare
compare.choose_when: Two or more named things must be told apart, and the same criteria apply to each.

boundaries.classify: instances are being sorted by a rule rather than two things contrasted
boundaries.diagnose-misconception: one side is a wrong belief, not a legitimate alternative
boundaries.evaluate: one option must be judged better, not merely distinguished

explain.label: Explain
explain.choose_when: The learner must reason about instances they have not seen, and the difficulty is the idea itself — not its cause, its flow, its arrangement, or a representation of it.

boundaries.explain-cause: the objective asks WHY, and a mechanism links cause to result
boundaries.trace-flow: something is followed as it moves or changes through a system
boundaries.show-structure: the difficulty is arrangement, containment, or hierarchy
boundaries.interpret: a specific representation is on the page and must be read

explain-cause.label: Explain cause and effect
explain-cause.choose_when: The objective asks why, or what happens if, and there is a mechanism between cause and result that the learner must be able to state.

boundaries.explain: there is no cause-and-effect chain, only meaning or structure
boundaries.trace-flow: the emphasis is on what moves, not on what causes
boundaries.sequence: order matters but no causal mechanism does
boundaries.derive: the chain is logical rather than physical

trace-flow.label: Trace the flow
trace-flow.pedagogical_role: Follow matter, energy, information, or value
trace-flow.choose_when: Something identifiable — matter, energy, information, money, data — enters, changes, moves, and leaves, and the learner must not lose track of it.

boundaries.sequence: the steps are actions taken, not a substance being followed
boundaries.explain-cause: the point is why it happens, not where it goes
boundaries.show-structure: the arrangement is static and nothing travels through it

demonstrate.label: Worked demonstration
demonstrate.choose_when: The learner has not yet seen the method carried out end to end on a real instance, and the method is unambiguous once seen. If the learner has already seen it worked through in this lesson, this condition is no longer met.

boundaries.model-thinking: the difficulty is choosing between approaches, not executing one
boundaries.derive: the result must be justified from prior statements, not computed
boundaries.practise-guided: the learner is attempting the work, not watching it

derive.label: Derive
derive.pedagogical_role: Build a result from prior statements
derive.choose_when: The result must be shown to FOLLOW from statements the learner already accepts, and each transformation needs a stated justification.

boundaries.demonstrate: the point is the procedure, not its justification
boundaries.model-thinking: steps are chosen from alternatives rather than compelled
boundaries.explain-cause: the chain is physical rather than logical

apply.label: Apply
apply.pedagogical_role: Use knowledge in a familiar situation

transfer.label: Transfer
transfer.pedagogical_role: Use knowledge in a changed context

practise-guided.label: Guided practice
practise-guided.choose_when: The learner can begin the task but will stall without prompts, partial steps, or hints.

boundaries.practise-independent: support would now be a crutch
boundaries.demonstrate: the learner is watching rather than attempting
boundaries.apply: the point is first unaided use, not scaffolded rehearsal

practise-independent.label: Independent practice
practise-independent.choose_when: The learner has already succeeded with support and must now perform unaided, with enough repetition for fluency.

boundaries.practise-guided: the learner has not yet succeeded with support
boundaries.check-understanding: the purpose is measurement, not rehearsal

check-understanding.label: Quick check
check-understanding.choose_when: The teacher needs to know right now whether the objective landed, and correct-versus-incorrect is the signal being read.

boundaries.diagnose-misconception: wrong answers must identify WHICH wrong model the learner holds
boundaries.practise-independent: the purpose is rehearsal rather than measurement

diagnose-misconception.label: Diagnose misconception
diagnose-misconception.pedagogical_role: Distinguish a known wrong model from the target model
diagnose-misconception.choose_when: A named, real misconception exists on the card, and a wrong answer can be written that only a learner holding it would confidently choose. One block per misconception the card declares — a misconception not on the card does not exist.

boundaries.check-understanding: no specific wrong model is known; the check only detects failure
boundaries.warn: the error is a slip or lapse, not a held belief

warn.label: Watch out
warn.choose_when: A specific error is predictable at this exact point, and naming it before it happens prevents it.

boundaries.diagnose-misconception: the error is a held belief that must be surfaced and tested, not a slip to flag
boundaries.emphasise: the content is a positive statement to retain, not an error to avoid

memory-aid.label: Memory aid
memory-aid.pedagogical_role: Support recall with a compact cue

summarise.label: Summarise
summarise.pedagogical_role: Compress the lesson into essential relationships

connect-forward.label: What comes next
connect-forward.pedagogical_role: Bridge current learning to the next idea

reflect.label: Reflect
reflect.pedagogical_role: Prompt learners to examine their understanding

evaluate.label: Evaluate
evaluate.pedagogical_role: Judge a claim, method, or evidence
